vision.title: What DIASPORALE is
vision.lead: The closed social network of Gabonese people living abroad: your country, your community, and you always know who is posting.

country.title: Your country, your community
country.body: A space for each host country (news, events, associations, businesses) and what matters to the whole diaspora.

settle.title: Settle in and help each other
settle.body: An arrival kit with dated resources, practical questions between members and volunteer mentors.

work.title: Work and do business
work.body: Job offers, talents visible by choice and the diaspora's services, from the request to the appointment.

associations.title: Associations, up close
associations.body: Their pages, their memberships, their calendar and their volunteer missions.

contact.title: Talk without exposing your contact details
contact.body: Contact goes through messaging: a “Write” button, never a displayed phone number.

closed.title: Reserved for Gabonese people abroad
closed.body: What is posted here stays here, unless its author chooses to share it on ANTSIA.

speaker.title: You always know who is speaking
speaker.body: Every account and every page carries a trust marker computed by the network, never self-declared.

verified.title: Verified with your consent
verified.body: consulat.ga confirms a consular registration and nothing else: no passport, no civil records, no file.

sponsored.title: Or sponsored
sponsored.body: A verified member who knows you can sponsor you; every sponsorship is recorded.

data.title: Your data, your choices
data.body: Separate, revocable consents, an opt-in directory, export and erasure from your settings.

free.title: Free for members
free.body: Access to the network is free; a professional service may have its own price.

steps.account: Create your account with a code received by email, no password.
steps.residence: Tell us where you live: your country of residence, then your consents, one by one.
steps.publish: Read right away; post after the consular verification or a sponsorship.
